title: SPY doji streak descriptive study v2
source: Alpaca 1-minute historical bars (free IEX feed, regular session)

method.streak: Exact D1, D2, ... position among consecutive completed same-color dojis in the selected candle style; non-doji, opposite color, missing interval, and session gaps reset the count.
method.observation: Next available published bar only when its close timestamp is within one selected interval; overnight and missing-bar transitions are excluded.
method.nextCloseFavorable: For green, next real SPY close > signal real SPY close; for red, next real SPY close < signal real SPY close. Ties count as not favorable. This is not an executable trade result.
method.nextBarSameColor: Next real SPY candle has the streak color, using close >= open for green and close < open for red.
method.nextSameColorDoji: Next displayed candle is another same-color doji, extending the streak.
method.baseline: Non-doji candles of the same displayed color, timeframe, and style with the same eligible next-bar rule. Flat no-range bars are excluded. This is a descriptive comparison, not a matched or causal test.
method.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals are descriptive binomial reference intervals; serial dependence and scanning many cells can make them too optimistic. No rule was selected or prospectively validated.
